testcase.system-out: Scenario: Sort recent rows by file size ✔ Given the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native` ✔ And the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And recent documents with different known file sizes are displayed in List View ✔ And Last Opened is the active descending sort ✔ When the user selects the Size column header ✔ Then the visible rows with known sizes are ordered from larger to smaller ✔ When the user selects the Size column header again ✔ Then the visible rows with known sizes are ordered from smaller to larger
